```{=html}
<div class="proj-card">
  <h3> Restaurant Recommendation System</h3>
  <div class="tech">Python · TensorFlow · LightGCN · Collaborative Filtering</div>
  <p>Top-K restaurant recommendation system built on 1.5M+ Google Local reviews. Reformulated explicit ratings as implicit feedback for personalized ranking across 98K+ users and 28K+ businesses. Trained a LightGCN graph neural network with BPR loss, achieving a <strong>20% improvement</strong> in Recall@10 and NDCG@10 over Popularity, Item-Item Jaccard, and Matrix Factorization baselines.</p>
  <a href="https://github.com/ziayan-analytics/recommendation-system-lightgcn" target="_blank">→ View on GitHub</a>
</div>

<div class="proj-card">
  <h3> Sentiment Analysis: DAN + BPE</h3>
  <div class="tech">Python · PyTorch · NLP · Deep Learning</div>
  <p>Implemented sentiment classification using Deep Averaging Networks (DAN) with pretrained GloVe embeddings, achieving ~79–80% dev accuracy. Also built a subword DAN variant using Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) with randomly initialized embeddings, and compared performance across vocabulary sizes (500, 1000, 3000). Includes a theoretical Skip-gram analysis.</p>
  <a href="https://github.com/ziayan-analytics/sentiment-analysis-dan-bpe" target="_blank">→ View on GitHub</a>
</div>

<div class="proj-card">
  <h3> CloudFront Log Processing with AWS EMR + Hive</h3>
  <div class="tech">AWS EMR · HiveQL · Amazon S3 · Distributed Computing</div>
  <p>End-to-end cloud data pipeline that parses semi-structured CloudFront access logs at scale. Ingests raw logs from S3 into an Amazon EMR cluster, builds a structured Hive external table using RegexSerDe, runs HiveQL aggregations (request volume by OS), and writes outputs back to S3. Same workflow scales to millions of records.</p>
  <a href="https://github.com/ziayan-analytics/aws-emr-hive-log-processing" target="_blank">→ View on GitHub</a>
</div>

<div class="proj-card">
  <h3> AI Feedback Automation Agent</h3>
  <div class="tech">TypeScript · Claude API · Cloudflare Workers</div>
  <p>Built AI-assisted workflow automation pipelines using the Claude API and Cloudflare Workers to automate feedback analysis, summarization, and operational reporting. Developed structured LLM-based reporting workflows to standardize outputs and improve scalable decision-making.</p>
  <a href="https://github.com/ziayan-analytics/feedback-agent" target="_blank">→ View on GitHub</a>
</div>
```
